```{r}
# Paw-print scatterplot
crime_scene <- data %>% filter(record_type == "crime_scene")

ggplot(data, aes(paw_length_cm, paw_width_cm, label = name, color = name)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = crime_scene,
    aes(xmin = paw_length_lower_cm, xmax = paw_length_upper_cm,
        ymin = paw_width_lower_cm, ymax = paw_width_upper_cm),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sava Sniffer" = "#3399FF", "Klara Cache" = "#0000FF",
                               "Lady Byte" = "#660099", "Kommissar RegEx" = "#0099FF",
                               "Vera Vector" = "#9966CC", "Crime-scene sample" = "#CC0033")) +
  labs(x = "Paw length (cm)", y = "Paw width (cm)", title = "Paw-print analysis") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```


```{r}
crime_scene <- data %>% filter(record_type == "crime_scene")
all_dogs <- data %>% filter(record_type == "suspect_reference")

heat_data <- bind_rows(all_dogs, crime_scene) %>%
  mutate(name = ifelse(record_type == "crime_scene", "Crime scene", name)) %>%
  select(name,
         `Hair length` = hair_length_cm,
         `Shaft thickness` = hair_diameter_um,
         `Undercoat density` = hair_undercoat_score_0_1,
         `Colour similarity` = hair_lightness_0_1,
         `Medulla ratio` = hair_medulla_ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(-name, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(scaled = (value - min(value)) / (max(value) - min(value))) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(heat_data, aes(x = feature, y = name, fill = scaled)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fff5f0", high = "red", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Relative\nvalue", title = "Hair evidence comparison") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
